strategy.offer: High-precision optical sensors, instruments, subsystems, and test equipment for satellite attitude control, rendezvous and docking, and Earth observation.
strategy.customers: Space agencies, satellite manufacturers, and commercial and institutional space programs worldwide.
strategy.why_we_win: Space missions demand extreme precision and robustness; the firm relies on proven products, quality, reliability, and trusted long-term customer relationships.
strategy.resources: Decades of optoelectronic engineering experience, skilled and motivated employees, strong technological capabilities, certified quality processes, and research and industry collaborations.
strategy.direction: Advance sensor and optical technologies for future space missions while expanding Earth-observation capabilities that provide useful data on our planet.

context.industry: Manufacture of computer, electronic and optical products

strategy.offer: Space-grade optical, electronic, and sensor systems for spacecraft guidance, docking, imaging, Earth observation, instrument electronics, testing, calibration, and related engineering services.
strategy.customers: Space agencies, satellite and spacecraft manufacturers, and operators needing reliable attitude control, navigation, docking, imaging, and observation capabilities.
strategy.why_we_win: They argue precision, reliability, certified quality, adaptable designs, and proven mission performance make customers trust them for critical applications.
strategy.resources: Basis includes experienced specialists, decades of space heritage, optical and optoelectronic know-how, clean-room and test infrastructure, and collaborative research-industry networks.
strategy.direction: Developing more compact, flexible, reprogrammable sensors and instruments for future spacecraft operations, smaller satellites, and expanded Earth observation applications.
